I am working in a MNC company who provide me the phone allowance 200 riyal for each month but after the 1732 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. Question: Assalam Alaikum, I am a software engineer and I would appreciate if you could help me answering this question. I work in IT company and as you know we need to work for different clients across the globe. Now I have got an oppurtunity from my current company in india to go and work there in Bank located at London. Though I will be paid from my company in India but I will be working for the bank and my company will bill for my workdone. Since I have a concern working in Bank could you please advise me on the same quickly. Appreciate your quick reply as I need to respond immediately. Answer ID: 30317 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 555/364/H=1432) Your concern is alright. In this case, there is only the fear of loss. Therefore, you should find out such a halal means in which there is no worry. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
